title: Requirements for UE in an SNPN

entities.name: SNPN-specific attempt counter for 3GPP access
entities.description: Counter maintained by UE for access attempts via 3GPP access in SNPN operation mode. Stored in non-volatile memory and erased when subscriber data is updated or USIM is removed.

entities.name: SNPN-specific attempt counter for non-3GPP access
entities.description: Counter maintained by UE for access attempts via PLMN when accessing SNPN services. Applicable only if UE supports accessing SNPN services via PLMN.

entities.name: Counter for entry considered invalid for 3GPP access events
entities.description: Counter tracking events where current SNPN entry is considered invalid for 3GPP access. Reset to zero when subscriber data is updated or USIM is removed.

entities.name: Counter for entry considered invalid for non-3GPP access events
entities.description: Counter tracking events where current SNPN entry is considered invalid for non-3GPP access. Applicable only if UE supports accessing SNPN services via PLMN.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: NAS message that may be received without integrity protection with various 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: NAS message that may be received without integrity protection with various 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: Timer T3247
entities.description: Timer started when UE receives unprotected REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT with specific 5GMM cause values. Duration varies based on cause value.

entities.name: Timer T3510
entities.description: Timer stopped when UE receives unprotected reject message with specific 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: Timer T3517
entities.description: Timer stopped when UE receives unprotected reject message with specific 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: State entered by UE when storing TAI in forbidden lists after receiving non-integrity protected NAS reject message.

entities.name: Unprotected reject message condition
entities.description: Condition where UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT without integrity protection before secure NAS message exchange is established.
